evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Universal mandate framing ('every new hire completes') enacts authority-ranking: a uniform requirement imposed on all newcomers, not a negotiated or reciprocal arrangement.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter

observations.why: Stating that the checklist replaced a prior system reports a governance substitution — one authority structure superseding another — but the relational signal is thin and propositional.
